title: Window Trim Blackout, Ceramic Coating – Gloss, Or Headlight Restoration at Vetro Auto Films (Up to 28% Off)
description:
Is your car's exterior looking a bit dull or dated? Consider an upgrade that can make a noticeable difference in both appearance and protection. Vetro Auto Films offers specialized services like chrome delete, ceramic coating, and headlight restoration. These treatments are designed to refresh your vehicle's finish and improve its overall presentation.
What We Offer
Choose one option below. All services are performed in-shop by appointment.

Option 1 – Chrome Delete (Window Trim Blackout):
What’s included: blackout wrap applied to exterior window trim for a clean “de-chromed” look.
How long will it take?: approx. 1–3 hours (varies by vehicle/trim complexity).

Option 2 – Ceramic Coating (Gloss + Easy Wash Protection):
What’s included: exterior wash + decontamination + prep, then ceramic coating applied for gloss, hydrophobic protection, and easier maintenance.
How long will it take?: drop-off required; approx. 1 day total (cure time included).

Option 3 – Headlight Restoration (Pair of Headlights):
What’s included: restore clarity by removing oxidation/haze on both headlights for improved appearance and visibility.
How long will it take?: approx. 45–90 minutes.

Note: Any add-ons not listed in the selected option (extra chrome pieces, paint correction, severely damaged headlights, etc.) are quoted and approved before work begins.
Why You Should Grab the Offer
This offer from Vetro Auto Films includes special pricing on select exterior upgrades, including a chrome delete for window-trim blackout, a ceramic coating for added gloss and protection, and headlight restoration to improve visibility. These services are performed in-shop by appointment, with options ranging from 45 minutes to a full day, depending on complexity. The ceramic coating is rated for up to 5 years, while the chrome delete offers a refreshed aesthetic. Headlight restoration aims to bring back clarity and improve light output. Limited vouchers are available, so act quickly to secure these upgrades.

review_samples.text:
I had a great experience with Vetro Auto for my headlight restoration. From start to finish, they were extremely responsive and easy to work with. The team was professional, friendly, and clearly takes pride in what they do.

They completed the work quickly without cutting corners, and the results speak for themselves, my headlights look like new again. It made a noticeable difference in both appearance and visibility.

If you’re considering this service, I’d absolutely recommend Vetro Auto. Quality work, great customer service, and efficient turnaround, hard to ask for more.
